0215271 2023-02-04 Support read/write of 4 sample/pixel rgba images in bmp format * Vlad Astakhov submitted a fix to allow reading rgba (ignoring the alpha).   Windows screengrabs apparently produce these. * Save the alpha component when reading rgba in bmp format. * For spp == 4 pix, save the alpha component when writing bmp. * Added a test section in ioformats_reg for miscellaneous tests.   In there, test write/read of rgba, including alpha, for both png and bmp.
427de3e 2022-05-04 Remove PROCNAME / procName and use __func__
e8b670d 2022-04-29 Split pix.h and array.h into a public interface and an internal interface * The internal files pix_internal.h and array_internal.h contain   definitions of the structs. * The rest is the public interface, with typedefs and flags. * Applications should use the public interface, which includes accessors   to the fields, but if necessary they can include the internal files. * Only twelve test programs in /prog require an internal file to be included. * These changes were suggested and promoted by Stefan Weil.  They are   a significant change to the ABI and will require increasing the .so   number of the library to 6.0.0.
d4ab740 2022-02-02 Make bmpio non-support of 32-bit bmp (rgba) explicit * leptonica support for bmp files is intended to be minimal: 1,2,4,8,16   bpp with 1 component; 24 bpp for RGB; 4 byte colormaps up to 256 colors;   no compression; no transparency. * 32 bpp bmp files made by windows screen grab have transparency and are   not supported.  Use png for images with transparency. * Decision not to support 32-bit bmp files may be revised in the future.
7c42450 2020-05-20 Fix oss-fuz issues 22377 and 22378: leaks during writing png * Make sure that colormap is valid * Also check validity for writing bmp, gif, spix
e1d5c88 2020-05-18 Fixed oss-fuzz issue 22323: Direct-leak in pixcmapCreate() * Always attach colormap to pix, even if not valid. * Check pixSetColormap() in I/O routines where the pix and colormap   depths may differ.
6988379 2020-01-03 Better handling of 1 bpp colormapped images.  Also: * removal of duplicated code in rotate1_reg.c * adding clear notification in reg test output when errors are expected * add some error checking (dewarp1.c, utils2.c)
002843b 2019-12-31 Yet another small restriction on bmp input data.
7a74abc 2019-12-28 More sanity-checking restrictions on input data in bmp files
50c3c35 2019-12-27 Fix bit shift overflow in bmp reading.

9540500 2019-12-24 Modified bmpio allow reading from files with newer formats. * No longer restrict the infoheader to be 40 bytes. * Add 2 bpp bmp file to mtiff_reg test. * Addresses issue #454
4f25104 2019-12-08 Replaced all fprintf(stderr, ...) with lept_stderr(...) in the library * This completes the stderr redirection. * Also included auto_config.h in this set of about 80 changed files
1480744 2019-11-09 In gplot, generate the pix directly with a single call * without having to specify a rootname and then generating the   file name to read it back.  This is done changing only       gplotSimpleXY1(), ...XY2() and ... XYN()   and adding new functions that call them:       gplotSimplePix1(), gplotSimplePix2(), gplotSimplePixN() * Also, several small mods to satisfy various compilers * Also, begin adding #include <config_auto.h> to all source files.   This must be added at the top, as the first non-comment statement.   Richard Daniel also pointed out that you shouls use <> instead   of quotes to be sure to get the config file of the build system,   if there is one. * Also fixed some potential leaks found by Coverity Scan. CS has   been broken for about 6 months, but Stefan Weil was able to   load the previous version and run it.
a194247 2019-07-20 Accommodate buggy readers that use the alpha byte with 3 bpp RGB images. * Some java tests have been trying to interpret the alpha byte for   RGB images.  We set the alpha byte to 255 (opaque), although it is   not necessary (issue #442). * Also, add caution about using orientation detector on tables (issue #466).
18abe3c 2019-03-22 Removed 'register' from the auto-generated files * 'register' declarations were deprecated as of C++-11. * modified the auto-generation software and templates to   generate proper Doxygen comments * This involved fixing 3 of the code generators (fhmtauto.c,   fmorphauto.c, stringcode.c), 5 of the templates (hmttemplate*.txt,   morphtempalte*.txt, stringtemplate1.txt), and regenerating 9 source   files of auto-genned code (dwacomb*.c, dwalinear*.c, fhmtgen*.c,   fmorphgen*.c, autogen.137.c).  Not something you want to do very often. Also: * More use of uint32 to avoid fuzzer complaints about 32 bit left shifts.   Most likely this wasn't a problem. * Removal of some unused #defines. * Increment version numbers beyond current release, to 1.79.

b88c821 2018-01-28 New implementation of pixWordMaskByDilation() * more robust, simpler, faster, fewer input args, better debugging output * also simplified pixGetWordsInTextlines(), pixGetWordBoxesInTextlines(),   and jbWordsInTextlines(). * better reg test prog/wordboxes_reg. * also use jpeg output for large images in texturefill_reg.c, instead of   png. The test is now 6x faster and the output images are 7x smaller. * Changes in several other progs due to simpler interfaces above. * Bug fix for bmp reading to set opacity. * Fix for potential injection attack using gplot rootdir.
af126bd 2017-12-03 More small improvements based on static code analysis: * logic simplifications * elimination of possible memory leaks * explicit casts from int to float where needed Also remove trailing spaces

5f0d17f 2017-04-17 Fixed bmpio for both 16 bpp and 2 bpp * for 16 bpp, properly reads and writes, without a colormap * for 2 bpp, converts to 8 bpp, saving the colormap if it exists. * added two colormap depth converters * added 4th mode for converting 16 bpp --> 8 bpp
b8cdbd9 2017-04-14 bmp I/O is rewritten to implement the memory version directly. * This is relatively simple because we don't handle compression,   so the size of the memory buffer is easily calculated. * The stream read interface is then implemented, as with webp,   as a combination of a file read and memory deserialization. * Likewise, the stream write interface is implemented as a   combination of serialization to memory followed by writing to file. * This avoids writing temp files on all platforms.

    Strict constraint on size of headers, colormap and data in bmp file.

diff --git a/src/bmpio.c b/src/bmpio.c
index 38b916d..80fddaf 100644
--- a/src/bmpio.c
+++ b/src/bmpio.c
@@ -209,13 +209,13 @@ PIXCMAP   *cmap;
     cmapbytes = offset - BMP_FHBYTES - BMP_IHBYTES;
     cmapEntries = cmapbytes / sizeof(RGBA_QUAD);
     if (cmapEntries < 0 || cmapEntries == 1)
         return (PIX *)ERROR_PTR("invalid: cmap size < 0 or 1", procName, NULL);
     if (cmapEntries > L_MAX_ALLOWED_NUM_COLORS)
         return (PIX *)ERROR_PTR("invalid cmap: too large", procName,NULL);
-    if (size < 1LL * offset + 1LL * fdatabpl * height)
+    if (size != 1LL * offset + 1LL * fdatabpl * height)
         return (PIX *)ERROR_PTR("size incommensurate with image data",
                                 procName,NULL);

         /* Handle the colormap */
     cmapBuf = NULL;
     if (cmapEntries > 0) {
